correctness.rationale: Read pinned RESULT.md and verify.py. Bayer et al give shellability and top homology concentration in r-1. Zhang--Yang nonfaces are connected k-subset complements (gaps ≤2) in level r, and interval (k+1)-complements in level r-1; all smaller sets are faces. On each invariant face with a transposed vertex-pair count a and central vertex indicator b, the oriented reduced Hopf trace is (-1)^r times Σ(-1)^{a+b}. The all-invariant-subset base sum reduces by alternating binomial identity; the unique central omitted interval for odd r and reversal-palindromic gap-word connected sets furnish the correction counts S(h,t). The four parity cases and (B±T)/2 follow. Independently generated cut-complex faces from disconnected-complement definition and computed oriented fixed-face traces for 45 parameter cases 5<=n<=13; all matched the piecewise formula. This corroborates but is not a finite-to-infinite inference.
